text: Your shower's probably the only ten minutes you get to yourself, so make it smell like Vicks. Eucalyptus and essential oils, plus that menthol and camphor scent. The Plus has ten percent more of that blend than the regular ones. Drop one on the shower floor, right where the water hits, and the steam fills up with it. It's non-medicated, so it's just for the smell. It won't treat a cold. Twelve in a box, so grab one for you and one to gift. It's in the orange cart.
